articles.title: Monero futures are again heating with leverage, raising volatility risks
articles.snippet: Open interest has topped $300 million and price is back above $600. A similar setup was seen before January's crash.

articles.title: Solana’s Alpenglow, its biggest network overhaul since 2020, goes live Wednesday
articles.snippet: Alpenglow will replace the voting system Solana has used since 2020, targeting roughly 150-millisecond finality after months of testing that included a failed migration and rollback.

articles.title: Solana’s Alpenglow launches on mainnet, targets 99% faster finality
articles.snippet: Solana’s first major consensus upgrade is targeting 99% finality reduction, seeking to offer users near-immediate transaction settlement and more responsive applications.

articles.title: France proposes liability for crypto exchanges offering DeFi access
articles.snippet: French authorities want crypto exchanges to conduct checks on DeFi protocols and face liability for certain customer losses under proposed changes to EU crypto rules.

articles.title: Who Found the PHP Bug That Made Governments Unplug Their Websites? ChatGPT, Of Course
articles.snippet: OpenAI says its models found PHP2Shell and led a two-month coalition to fix it. It's the same AI that broke into Hugging Face and an Australian government portal this year.
